## Remarks

The fully-rendered block is SENT (never edited) to every entry of `broadcast.ids` with its own language code from `broadcast.languageCode`<!-- -->; `keyboard`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, `AGBaseId`<!-- -->, `options`<!-- -->, and `rich` are forwarded. The fan-out pacing uses `broadcast.chunkSize`<!-- -->/`broadcast.chunkDelayMs`<!-- -->, so the top-level `chunkSize` is never read — and `mode`<!-- -->, the edit-only keys, and `fallback` are never read either, since nothing edits.
